question.text: What is the minimum subscription amount for debt oriented and balanced schemes at the time of NFO?

explanation.text: The Logic: The minimum subscription amount at NFO for debt-oriented and balanced schemes is at least Rs 20 crore, while other schemes have a minimum of Rs 10 crore (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, p.251). The Trap: Rs 10 crore is the threshold for other schemes (such as equity), not for debt-oriented or balanced schemes. Note: Anchor on the source-backed Rs 20 crore vs Rs 10 crore split on p.251 rather than reasoning from corpus or diversification considerations.
